description: IDProtect is a CM based on the Athena OS755 Java Card 2.2.2 GlobalPlatform 2.1.1 smart card OS with 72KB EEPROM validated to FIPS 140-2 Level 3 supporting DRBG, TDES, AES, SHA-1 and -256, and RSA 2048 bits with on card keygen exposing PKI/biometric APIs designed for high-performance government/enterprise applications.
version: Inside Secure AT90SC generation U H1.0 (Firmware)
